note: Adapted from Chhotani (1997), entry 2 (p. 578); the alate is recorded as Unknown in the original, so only the soldier and worker are covered; both worker forms are combined.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae pale orange; labrum and postmentum yellow; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at the base. Body length 3.30–4.0. Head capsule nearly square (length to mandible base 0.60–0.65, maximum width 0.75–0.80). Fontanelle small, dot-like. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 the shortest. Labrum lanceolate (length 0.30–0.33, maximum width 0.20–0.23). Mandibles short and stout (length 0.50–0.53, index 0.60–0.63). Postmentum arched (length 0.45, maximum width 0.35–0.38). Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.35, maximum width 0.48–0.53).

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Major worker: head capsule pale yellow, postclypeus and labrum the same colour; antennae, thorax and body pale yellow; pilosity of head and body of medium density. Body length 3.5–4.30. Head capsule nearly square (length to mandible base 0.80, maximum width 0.87). Antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 longer than segment 3, segment 4 the shortest. Pronotum width 0.46. Minor worker: smaller, body length 3.0, maximum head width 0.68, pronotum width 0.42.
